Ava (Finance): Heads up — April close: discovered $42,350 of earned-but-unbilled customer usage across 4 accounts. Need decision on accrual vs hold as deferred. Details below.
MonthEndBot: unbilled-usage report generated 2026-04-01T01:12Z | report_id: run-2321 | total_unbilled: $42,350 | file: /files/unbilled_apr_2026.csv :mag_right: 
Liam (Revenue Ops): For usage that's been delivered/consumed we should accrue (Dr Unbilled Receivable / Cr Revenue). Prepaid/annual fees stay deferred. Can we confirm cutoff times and any contract terms that say invoiced monthly vs usage-billed?
Sana (Accounting): Agree with accrual for earned & unbilled. GL accounts: AR-Unbilled (1310) / Revenue-Usage (4105). Need customer support evidence/logs per customer and a note for audit.
Jae (Invoice Ops): Noted. One of the four (acme) has a usage dispute flagged 4/20 — legal requested we hold that portion until investigation. I flagged the CSV. There's also two vendor invoices hitting AP this period that will offset COGS; separate line item.
Ava (Finance): CSV calc snippet from the run: 
```csv
customer,period,units,rate,amount
acme,2026-04-01 to 2026-04-30,13000,2.00,26000
nova,2026-04-01 to 2026-04-30,95000,0.10,9500
plank,2026-04-01 to 2026-04-30,6300,1.00,6300
halo,2026-04-01 to 2026-04-30,550,1.00,550
TOTAL,,,$,42350
```
Ava (Finance): Acme dispute amount per legal is $7,500 (spike on 4/20). Proposal: exclude disputed $7.5k from accrual this month. That means accrue $34,850 now; monitor dispute for potential reversal.
Liam (Revenue Ops): Sounds right. Accrue only amounts we can substantiate as earned. Put disputed items on a separate tracking schedule.
Sana (Accounting): If we exclude dispute, proposed JE: 
```text
Dr 1310 Unbilled Receivable 34,850
  Cr 4105 Revenue - Usage 34,850
Memo: Accrual for earned but unbilled usage Apr 2026; excludes acme dispute $7,500 (ticket: LEG-473).
```
Sana (Accounting): Also need a reversing entry template for the next period in case invoice posts next month or dispute resolves: create AR-Unbilled -> AR-Invoice when invoiced.
Jae (Invoice Ops): I'll flag the acme rows and add a comment to billing ticket so we don't auto-invoice disputed portion. Also will route the vendor AP timing notes to POs channel — not to mix with revenue.
Ava (Finance): Who can approve the accrual JE? Liam, can you confirm revenue ops sign-off so I can post in the close checklist?
Liam (Revenue Ops): Approved from revenue ops side. I confirm supporting logs attached to the report for nova/plank/halo. Acme support evidence pending legal hold for the $7.5k.
MonthEndBot: close-checklist update: accrual_pending -> posted by Finance after approvals. checklist_id: close-2026-04-01-42k
Ava (Finance): Thanks — I'll post the JE and attach the CSV + contract snippets. Leaving note to explain rationale in the close working papers. :white_check_mark:
Sana (Accounting): One more ask — tag the JE with customer IDs and include the dispute ticket link for audit.
Ava (Finance): Will do.
Jae (Invoice Ops): FYI — I'll follow up with billing on timing so we don't double-bill if dispute resolves quickly.
Liam (Revenue Ops): Good. If dispute resolves in favor of customer, we'll reverse the accrual and credit revenue accordingly. If not, we keep recognition as posted.
Ava (Finance): OK closing this thread — posting JE now and updating month-end binder.
